title: Adding a service to a work order writes a work order note
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset enrolled on a schedule (standard enrolment steps).
  3. The asset's PM-A (schedule "Highway Tractor PM") is listed on the worklist; you hold create and edit work orders.
custom_steps:
1. On the worklist press Create work order on the PM-A row.
  2. On the new work order open its notes and read the note added.
  3. Read the lines added and whether each carries its own origin tag.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A work order opens with PM-A's lines.
  • The work order carries an internal note naming the service and schedule it came from: "PM-A added from Highway Tractor PM".
  • Lines need not carry a per-line origin tag (it may come later). The matching audit entry cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R2, S21-E1, S21-N3); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 1 requirement table, S17-R5; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S21-R2: “Adding a service to a work order will write both a work order note and an audit entry, naming the schedule and service it came from”
  • Plan 1 §1 S17-R5: “One short internal WO note "{service} added from {schedule}" ("PM-A added from Highway Tractor PM")”
  • S21-E1: “Where the note and the audit entry record the origin, a per line tag is cosmetic and can be deferred”
  • S21-N3: “No screen shows the audit in v1”
